title: NVIDIA/warp

It wraps MuJoCo environments in Gymnasium with synchronous execution and supports common robot platforms including Franka, UR5e, xArm, SO101, and YAM, making it useful for teams that want a lighter-weight path from simulation experiments to real robot control.

extra.full_text: Isaac Lab - Arena is a robotics simulation framework that enhances NVIDIA Isaac Lab by providing a composable, scalable system for creating diverse simulation environments and evaluating robot learning policies. The framework enables developers to rapidly prototype and test robotic tasks with various robot embodiments, objects, and environments.

title: Specializing AI for Regulated Industries - How Domyn Uses NVIDIA Nemotron
summary: Regulated industries require full ownership,control and customization of the models they deploy with end-to-end governance, transparency, and auditability.

extra.full_text: Regulated industries require full ownership,control and customization of the models they deploy with end-to-end governance, transparency, and auditability. This livestream explores how Domyn has built and specialized its own models, including a 263B-parameter reasoning model purpose-built for regulated industries and smaller models for specific domains and tasks. We'll walk through the training pipeline: model compression, multilingual continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, leveraging the NVIDIA open source ecosystem. Learn how this approach delivers state-of-the-art results on enterprise tasks like text-to-SQL, knowledge graph extraction, and safety classification, and enable AI that you can own, control and customize, built for the demands of regulated industries.

title: IFAC 세계대회서 ‘웨어러블 로봇 챌린지’ 성료…6개국 학생들, 동일 로봇 플랫폼 위에서 아이디어 겨뤄
summary: At IFAC World Congress 2026 in Busan, student researchers from six countries competed in a Wearable Robot Challenge using the same wearable robot platform, turning their own control and assistance ideas into working systems. The event matters because it created a controlled comparison across teams: different algorithms and design choices were tested on shared hardware rather than isolated custom platforms.

extra.full_text: 세계 각국의 학생 연구자들이 동일한 웨어러블 로봇 플랫폼을 활용해 자신만의 아이디어를 실제 시스템으로 구현하는 국제 로봇 경진대회가 부산에서 열렸다.지난 8월 24일부터 26일까지 부산 벡스코에서 열린 ‘IFAC 웨어러블 로봇 챌린지 2026’이 성공적으로 마무리됐다. 이번 대회는 ‘제23차 국제자동제어연맹(IFAC) 세계대회 2026’의 경쟁 프로그램으로 진행됐으며, 한국로봇산업진흥원의 지원을 받아 개최됐다.대회 주최는 이인호 부산대 교수, 최현진 상명대 교수, 김현식 동명대 교수, 권정한 부산대 교수, 최정수 영남대 교수, 정진
